title: GrantCreateScope
description: The scope of grant.create (docs/design/m0/04 "Grants"): the grant to create, under an id the client mints (grt_…, which must not exist), for a live supervisor other than the caller. valid_from, issued_by and approval are never the caller's: the controller sets valid_from to the time the grant is applied, issued_by to the operator who applied it (the confirmer, for a confirmed proposal) and approval to the approval that confirmed it (null when an operator issued it directly). A supervisor's grant.create is a human-policy proposal, never confirmed by its grantee.

expires_at.description: Required: every grant expires, after the time it is applied.
